fields.Name: ORD-05 - Subscription Cancellation
fields.Description: Orders.CancelSubscription end to end (SC1-SC10, design section 5). The user picks a DATE; the operation applies CancellationMode / CancellationRefundMode / CancellationWindowDays / GracePeriodDays, derives the reversal fraction itself, and emits the reversal order atomically. Covers Preview (compute without writing), EndOfTerm + NoRefund (ride the term out, reverse nothing, complete the term), ProrateUnused (refund the unused fraction and reverse exactly that much), mirrored journal entries, the guard that stops a reversal line minting a second subscription, term and subscription stamping, grace reflected in EndDate, the lifecycle event, double-cancellation refusal, and logical failure returned as OUTPUT rather than thrown.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Preview writes nothing; EndOfTerm+NoRefund completes the term with zero reversal; a ProrateUnused cancellation reverses the unused fraction with mirrored Dr Deferred / Cr AR entries equal to the refund; grace extends EndDate past the effective date; a second cancellation is refused; an unknown subscription returns Success:false.
